changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SynchedAssetType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [IntegrationSettingID] [int] NOT NULL, [SourceAssetTypeName] [varchar](500) NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Object] AS ([integration].[GetObjectByAssetTypeId]([AssetTypeID])), [ObjectID] AS ([integration].[GetObjectIDByAssetTypeId]([AssetTypeID])), [ToGovern] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationAssetType_ToGovern] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Active] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationAssetType_Active] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [OptionalIDName] [varchar](50) NULL, [OptionalID] [int] NULL, [LastSynchOn] [datetime] NULL, [LastSuccessfulCount] [int] NULL, [AllowChangeDetection] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationSynchedAssetType_AllowChangeDetection] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Level] [int] NULL, [TriggerTopicMessage] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationSynchedAssetType_TriggerTopicMessage] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [PageSize] [int] NULL, [RefreshIntervalOverride] [int] NULL, [FieldPageSize] [int] NULL, [RelationshipPageSize] [int] NULL, [OwnershipPageSize] [int] NULL, [DeleteExecutionTimeoutHours] [int] NULL, [EnableAppInsightsVerboseLogging] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationSynchedAssetType_EnableAppInsightsVerboseLogging] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [ClearFieldHashInterval] [int] NULL, [ClearOwnershipHashInterval] [int] NULL, [ClearRelationshipHashInterval] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationSynchedAssetType] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetType_IntegrationSetting') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetType] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetType_IntegrationSetting] FOREIGN KEY([IntegrationSettingID]) REFERENCES [integration].[Setting] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetType] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetType_IntegrationSetting] END
